headline: Sales momentum broadens as data-center demand lifts margins
summary_short: Wesco's Q2 FY2026 revenue rose to $6,665.1M (+13.0% y/y, +12.6% organic), with net income of $209.0M and diluted EPS of $4.23, both up double digits y/y as data-center-driven demand lifted volume across all three segments.
summary_long: Net sales grew 13.0% y/y (12.6% organic) on ~10% volume growth across EES, CSS and UBS plus ~3% price, led by CSS's data-center solutions business (+18.4% sales, EBITDA margin 10.2% vs 8.8%). UBS grew more modestly (+7.0%) with margin compression. Gross margin improved (COGS 78.2% of sales vs 78.9%), partly offset by SG&A up 17.3% on payroll and digital-transformation costs. Interest expense rose $17.5M on higher term debt and a $10.0M loss from redeeming the 2028 Notes; leverage improved to 3.0x from 3.4x. Cash grew to $808.9M; Wesco paid $0.500/share in dividends and repurchased $25.3M of stock. Post-quarter, it closed the ~$135.0M Newark Engineering acquisition. No forward guidance was given.

drivers.explanation: Sales momentum reflects volume growth across all three segments, led by CSS's data-center solutions business, with record year-over-year backlog growth across EES, CSS and UBS.
Growth reflects an approximate 10% increase in volume driven by all three segments, plus an approximate 3% benefit from price.
Cost of goods sold fell to 78.2% of sales from 78.9%, reflecting improved gross margins in EES and CSS, partially offset by a decline in UBS.
Increase primarily reflects higher net sales and lower cost of goods sold as a percentage of sales, partially offset by higher SG&A as a percentage of sales.

Higher operating income was partly offset by $17.5M more net interest expense (higher term debt plus a $10.0M non-cash loss on 2028 Notes extinguishment) and a lower effective tax rate (22.9% vs 26.1%) from discrete stock-award tax benefits.
Wesco issued 5.250% 2031 Notes and 5.500% 2034 Notes in Q1 to fund the June 2026 redemption of its 7.250% 2028 Notes, pushing out its next significant debt maturity to 2029.
